name: Herm's Inn (Logan, UT) "The Cuban" Slow-Roasted Pork & Smoked Ham on Sourdough
whyItWorks: Tender slow-roasted pulled pork, smoked ham, and Swiss cheese on pressed sourdough. Holding spicy sriracha mayo keeps it mild and easily digested.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order The Cuban on sourdough with yellow mustard instead of sriracha mayo; hold spicy pickles upon request.
watchOuts: Request plain yellow mustard or mayo instead of sriracha mayo
